description: Append-only ledger node: seals segments, signs blocks, agrees a post-quantum replication key.

toolchain.notes: JAVA_HOME must point at a JDK. The ML-KEM call site compiles on 21 because the algorithm is a JCA string; it resolves only on a Java 24+ runtime, and App falls back cleanly when it does not.

file_assets.note: PKCS#12 keystore, throwaway test material. The askable asset is the container itself. It holds a P-256 key and certificate, but that is behind password-based encryption, so no static scanner can name the inner key algorithm without the password; expecting it was a ground-truth error. See docs/pending-review.md entry 4.
